sources.title: 魏了翁《鶴山先生大全文集》卷五十三〈鄒淮百中經序〉四部叢刊系受讀
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/鶴山先生大全文集_(四部叢刊本)/文集五十三
sources.quality_notes: Target passage explicitly reports 七政四暗曜, birth 年月日時, Zou Huai's astral-calendar expertise and official stipend, the 1144 甲子 data start, lunar mansion and palace degrees, and the reported saying on 三命 versus 五星. The received text has 親舊行; original folio not inspected. Sibu header reports Jiayetang Song-print facsimile, not proof of the target physical leaf.

sources.title: 魏了翁《鶴山集》卷053〈鄒淮百中經序〉四庫系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Shared clauses on eleven luminaries, 1144 data start, lunar mansion/palace degrees and official astronomy vs natal application; Siku reads 新舊行 against Sibu 親舊行. No original glyph adjudication, no independent physical witness or identical recension claim.

sources.title: 國圖 rarecatx0509316《重校鶴山先生大全文集》1929四部叢刊影印本
sources.provider: Taiwan National Central Library Chinese rare-book union catalog
sources.quality_notes: First-party catalog states 110 juan, 1929 Commercial Press facsimile of Song print and title-page seal identifying Hanhfenlou loan from Liu Jiayetang. Bibliographic statement only; neither target physical leaf nor identity of this exact modern copy with Wikisource transcription confirmed.

sources.title: 趙江紅〈五星是歷：星曜行度文獻源流考〉2019文章開頭公開轉載
sources.provider: Reference Network repost of 自然科学史研究 2019 issue 4
sources.quality_notes: Public excerpt distinguishes recorded star positions from calculating them and states a proposed later Qizheng Taili continuation. Full article and comparative tables not read; repost date July 18 is displayed site metadata, not verified print issue date. Treat proposal as secondary research lead, not established physical genealogy.
